_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil—score moved ±2 in only 3% of recent windows—so HOLD is the graded base rate until a named breaker (range break + fear/funding impulse) appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Anxiety phase; analyst explicitly HOLD, narrative silent on direction (low conf)
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear_greed holds 30s, funding near flat, no ETF/CVD impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break with fear_greed leaving 30s—either liquidation flush (score -1 rung) or flow-led squeeze (score +1 rung)
